shared_elements: bearded male head in strict profile
curled/beaded hair and beard rendered as rows of stylized curls
headdress or crown covering the top of the head
almond-shaped frontal eye set in a profile face
justification: Both depict a single bearded male head in strict profile in low relief, with the beard and hair rendered as dense regular rows of curls, a large frontally-shown almond eye with heavy brow, prominent nose, and a tall headdress band above the fillet-bound hair — a highly specific and conventional scheme shared point for point (only mirrored in facing direction). The main differences are the headdress type (a ribbed/fluted tall crown versus a pointed, layered banded cap) and the presence of a shoulder/garment area in A, but these are variations within what appears to be the same iconographic tradition.
